meta.name: victorian_seaside_resort
meta.prompt: A Victorian seaside resort on a fair day: a long promenade with a bandstand, a paddle steamer moored at the end of the pleasure pier, and hot-air balloons rising over the beach.

tokens.terrain: a sandy coastline and wide beach facing open sea beside a Victorian seaside resort town
tokens.icons: a grand seafront promenade with a central bandstand; a pleasure pier stretching into the sea with a paddle steamer moored at its end; hot-air balloons rising over the sandy beach; a bustling seaside fairground
tokens.infra: grand seafront esplanade and pleasure pier
